lines.speaker: quarter_regular
lines.text: Your friend's been staring at the founder's portrait over the bar for ten minutes. Everybody stares at it, it's a terrible portrait. Nobody stares at it like that.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: It is a good likeness. They have made the jaw heavier, which they always do — it happens to everyone who gets painted after they stop being able to object.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: And the man at the end of the bar has looked at me four times and is now reaching for a handset. I have spent my whole life being the one who makes that call. I would quite like to be on the other side of it for once.

choices.text: We leave. You are not a curiosity.
